item: Bounded body reads and directory pins for the World Bank, Eurostat, OWID grapher and JSON-stat fetchers (R584)
summary: R319 release note: the four official-statistics fetchers no longer read a response without limit. Each streams its body under a bound derived from the request's own shape (World Bank per_page, Eurostat's documented 50,000-value query limit, OWID areas x years, JSON-stat max_cells) and abandons the read when it passes it; World Bank, Eurostat and OWID grapher sessions are pinned to their own host and API directory. The Eurostat limit is documented, not verified live, and the timeout still bounds each read rather than the whole transfer.
